_purpose: Room 4D — Project 001 (Insurance License Exam). Permanent domain map for the knowledge/curriculum architecture. Domain IDs and topic names are stable identifiers: knowledge-points.json references domains by id and groups points under these topic labels. Do not renumber or rename an existing domain id/topic once knowledge points depend on it — add a new one instead.

domains.name: Insurance Fundamentals
domains.description: Foundational risk and insurance concepts underlying every other domain.

domains.name: Insurance Contracts
domains.description: Legal structure and doctrines that make an insurance policy a valid, enforceable contract.

domains.name: Life Insurance Products
domains.description: Product types and their common personal and business uses.

domains.name: Policy Provisions & Benefits
domains.description: Standard contract provisions, riders, and benefit mechanics found within a life insurance policy.

domains.name: Annuities, Retirement & Taxation
domains.description: Annuity structures, retirement accumulation/distribution mechanics, and their tax treatment.

domains.name: Underwriting & Insurance Operations
domains.description: How risks are evaluated, classified, and priced before and after policy issue.

domains.name: California Insurance Law & Regulation
domains.description: California-specific licensing, conduct, and regulatory requirements governing agents and brokers.

domains.name: Social Security & Retirement Benefits
domains.description: Federal Social Security program mechanics relevant to retirement and insurance planning.
